title: Correct time t1
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the final numerical expression for t1 in terms of t0, specifically (3√3/(4π)) t0.

title: Correct magnetic field B
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the final numerical expression for B in terms of E and v0, specifically √3 (E/v0).

title: Electric acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply kinematics or work-energy to relate the electric force, distance OB, and the final speed v0.

title: Magnetic circular motion
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion (qvB = mv²/R) to relate v0, B, and the orbit radius.

title: Geometry of trajectory
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the 30° geometry to relate the arc length or chord AB to the cyclotron radius and the time t0.

title: Consistent unit handling
description: Optional Criteria: The solution demonstrates dimensional consistency or explicitly states units for final answers.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The solution incorrectly assigns the direction of force, velocity, or field, leading to a sign error in a key relation.

title: Incorrect arc angle
description: Pitfall Criteria: The solution misidentifies the central angle of the magnetic arc (e.g., using 30° instead of 60° or 120°) for the travel time or radius relation.
